title: frames-devnet-1
announcements:
**Scope.** Second devnet for [EIP-8141 Frame Transactions](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8141), adding the frame-tx companion EIPs [EIP-8250 Keyed Nonces](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8250) and [EIP-8272 Recent Roots](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8272). Scoping them now matters because the ongoing FOCIL + Frames spec work already assumes both EIPs.
EL-only feature devnet: the EL activates **Bogota** at the Heze fork epoch while the CL side of Heze is suppressed (`FRAMES_ENABLED=true` in ethereum-genesis-generator)
Clients at genesis: TBD (devnet-0 ran geth, nethermind, reth + lighthouse; ethrex joined after [ethrex PR-7305](https://github.com/lambdaclass/ethrex/pull/7305)).
